in_marathi.name: Vala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vala in Hinduism is derived from the Sanskrit word 'valah' which means 'protector'. This name is associated with strength, power, and the ability to shield one from harm.
